queries.exists: SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name LIKE 'Spyder %' AND publisher = 'Spyder-IDE';
queries.patched: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name LIKE 'Spyder %' AND publisher = 'Spyder-IDE' AND version_compare(version, '6.1.6') < 0);
queries.open: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM processes WHERE LOWER(name) = 'spyder.exe');
